pages.title: WMO State of the Climate in Asia 2024

facts.text: Publisher: World Meteorological Organization (WMO) — SG Celeste Saulo
facts.head: Key findings

facts.text: Asia warming: at twice the global average; 2024 warmest year on record in Asia
facts.head: Key findings

facts.text: Global 2024: highest since 1850 (beat 1.45 °C of 2023) — all six datasets
facts.head: Key findings

facts.text: Warming 1991–2024: almost double 1961–1990
facts.head: Key findings

facts.text: Sea level rise: above global average on Pacific and Indian Ocean sides
facts.head: Key findings

facts.text: Glaciers: 23 of 24 monitored glaciers (central Himalaya, Tian Shan) lost mass
facts.head: Key findings

facts.text: Event: India heatwaves; Detail: over 450 deaths
facts.head: Extremes in 2024

facts.text: Event: Myanmar; Detail: record 48.2 °C on 28 April 2024
facts.head: Extremes in 2024

facts.text: Event: Makkah; Detail: 49 °C in June

facts.text: Event: UAE; Detail: 259.5 mm in 24 h (most since 1949)
facts.head: Extremes in 2024

facts.text: Event: Wayanad (Kerala); Detail: over 500 mm in 48 h (30 July), 350+ deaths

facts.text: Cyclone: Remal; Detail: Bay of Bengal; landfall 26 May near Mongla & Khepupara (Bangladesh/West Bengal); 111 km/h; 2.5 m surge
facts.head: Cyclones 2024

facts.text: Cyclone: Dana, Fengal; Detail: Bay of Bengal; Fengal hit India after skirting Sri Lanka (Nov)
facts.head: Cyclones 2024

facts.text: Cyclone: Asna; Detail: Arabian Sea, August — ⚠ only 3rd such since 1891; 3–5 m waves in Oman
facts.head: Cyclones 2024

facts.text: ⚠ Remal did not hit Oman — Asna affected Oman
